up: List all compounds associated with the document CHEMBL5725593. For each compound, return its molecule ChEMBL ID, its preferred name (pref_name if available), and its canonical SMILES (if available). Only list each distinct compound once.
sql: WITH doc AS (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725593') SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM doc JOIN compound_records cr ON doc.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE cr.molregno IS NOT NULL;
